01 / PRODUCT SCOPE

A decision system for the Tech Lead workflow.

The first release focuses on architecture interviews and production troubleshooting. It advises, cites assumptions and proposes reversible actions; it never changes production automatically.

01

Architecture

Capture context and constraints, model boundaries and explain technology trade-offs.

SYSTEM DESIGN · ADR · RISKS
02

Troubleshooting

Correlate symptoms, telemetry and runbooks into ranked, testable hypotheses.

METRICS · LOGS · TRACES
03

Code intelligence

Inspect approved repositories to identify coupling, obsolescence and evolution opportunities.

GITHUB · QUALITY · UPGRADES
04

Action planning

Return P0–P2 recommendations with evidence, limitations and human approval gates.

RUNBOOK · PRIORITY · AUDIT

Measurement rule

04 / ENGINEERING DECISIONS

Production thinking before AI autonomy.

ADR / 01

AI outside the transactional core

Business requests never depend on an LLM. ATLAS is an advisory path, so model latency or failure cannot break a production transaction.

ISOLATION · AVAILABILITY · COST
ADR / 02

Human approval before mutation

Rollback, scaling, deployment and configuration changes require explicit approval and an audit trail.

SAFETY · ACCOUNTABILITY · BLAST RADIUS
ADR / 03

Modules before more services

RAG and MCP begin inside the Intelligence Service. They split only when scaling, security or release cadence provides measurable value.

BOUNDARIES · COMPLEXITY · EVOLUTION
